Diagnosis of heart disease (1 = disease present, 0 = no disease) - prediction target

Resting blood pressure in mm Hg on admission to the hospital

Resting electrocardiographic results (0 = normal, 1 = ST-T wave abnormality, 2 = probable/definite left ventricular hypertrophy)
Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise testing

Slope of the peak exercise ST segment (0 = upsloping, 1 = flat, 2 = downsloping)
